summary: You want, and you pursue. There's heat in how you love. Desire and friction run together in you, so attraction can feel like a chase, and a chase can feel like a fight.
body: You want, and you pursue. There's heat in how you love. Desire and friction run together in you, so attraction can feel like a chase, and a chase can feel like a fight. Relationships light up fast around you and can burn just as fast. You may go after what you want with everything, or pick the spark over the substance every time. The work is letting the heat fuel something instead of consuming it.
gift: At your best: magnetic, alive, unafraid to want and to go get it.
shadow: The trap: mistaking intensity for compatibility, and friction for passion.
integration: Let love and values and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.
do: Aim the heat at building, not just chasing
Notice when a fight is standing in for closeness
dont: Confuse a spark with a foundation
Pick friction because calm feels boring
